explanation: From main: Dataset intake is unchanged. build_query_index.mts and build_tracker_catalog.mts only reword comments (the expr family has no app reader now; the reverse index feeds the library record), trackColumns/trackData comments drop CrossDatasetCompare, and How to cite gains a citations section. queryIndex.ts also drops the unused manifestSupportsExpr check; the index wire and build are unchanged. From the cross-study listing: No dataset registration, bundle builder, sidecar or query index format changed. The row builders add a tier derived from the q and p they already read, so a dataset change still produces the same bundles and index shards; only how the views order and label those rows moved into src/statistics.
